title: STLTH Starter Kit Bundle – Tobacco
description:
STLTH is the S in S-Compatible vape pods. Bundled with our top two STLTH Pod flavours, this is a great bundle for anyone searching out tobacco flavours in pod form!

STLTH Tobacco Bundle

- 1 x STLTH Device

- 1 x STLTH Skipper by Rope Cut Pack (3 x 2ml)

- 1 x STLTH Tobacco Blend (3 x 2ml)

- Savings of $5.00

Skipper by Rope Cut, a blend of tobacco and creamy vanilla, is a top seller not only as STLTH pods but as e-liquids too. This unique blend is popular both with tobacco enthusiasts and those craving more decadent flavours. Over the years we have confidently recommended Skipper both to customers adamant they only want tobacco and those looking for flavours outside the Fruit and Mint norms.

STLTH Tobacco Blend doesn’t need much explanation, it is a medium tobacco and well rounded crowd pleaser.

STLTH Devices are compatible with all s-compatible (s-type) pre-filled pods including ALLO SYNC, Flavour Beast Pods and G-Blast Pods. If you don’t love the flavours included in this bundle, there are lots more to explore! Only available for online purchase.
